points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Immutable historical attempt contains all packages and validator passes; Re200 metadata incorrectly reports strict target success and periodicity.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical attempt validation passes eight cases and report; this does not establish strict inner convergence or physical shedding.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 report and forces show no shedding, while metadata asserts periodic and final ratio1.08275 against0.001. Other cases retain mixed convergence limits.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Historic sanity data provide per-case CL/CD; Re20 Cd4.52 and Re200 Cd4.02/no shedding remain material physical limitations.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical force/residual plots exist. NACA Mach/pressure views are sparse scatter, cylinder plots collapse to a narrow strip. Re200 Mach plot is pixel-identically reproduced with triangle-to-cell mapping error; no figure embedded in historical main PDF.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Historical four-page PDF is readable and honestly discloses no shedding, but claims 100% inner success and curated source fails clean TeX build; figures are separate.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Immutable attempt contains raw CSVs, figure manifest and sanity summaries; historical binary is unbound. Re200 Mach plot reproduction proves 10173/10185 triangle indices map to wrong parent cells.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
